if not os.path.exists("sensor_defeatured_mm.step"):
    asm_ = import_step(STEP_IN)
    sol_ = asm_.solids()
    out_ = []
    for s in sol_:
        sm = [f for f in s.faces() if getattr(f, 'radius', None) is not None and f.radius <= R_SMALL]

    defeat_mm = Compound(children=out_)
